title: Desk market v0
description: One market format for every kind a desk installs (ADR 0107): an index of entries, each a theme, design system, view, pack or plugin with its version, bundle, sha256, size, permissions, engines, publisher and licence, and the .desk-plugin bundle an entry points at. It generalises the theme market (ADR 0060).

format.description: The index format and its version.

entries.description: What the market offers, each id once.

MarketKind.description: What an entry's bundle holds: a theme or a design system (their own bundles, ADR 0060 and 0091), a view plugin, a pack, or any other plugin (code: ui, logic, tool, connector, policy, library).

MarketEntry.description: One thing a market offers: its card, its bundle and what it asks.

license.description: An SPDX licence expression for the bundle and its assets.

sha256.description: The sha256 of the bundle's bytes, lowercase hex: a download that differs is refused.

size.description: The bundle's size in bytes, 16 MiB at most.

permissions.description: What the plugin asks, as its manifest does: shown before an install, asked again when an update adds one.

MarketEngines.description: The desks the bundle runs on.

desk.description: The Desk versions, as a minimum: >=0.1.0.

MarketUrl.description: Where the bundle is: a path relative to the index (views/today-plus.desk-plugin) or an https URL.

PluginBundle.description: A plugin as one file, a .desk-plugin: JSON, 16 MiB at most, holding its plugin.json and every file of its folder, base64. Themes and design systems travel as .desk-theme and .desk-design (ThemeBundle).

format.description: The bundle format and its version.

files.description: The plugin's files by their path in its folder (forward slashes, no .. and no dot files), each base64; plugin.json is the manifest.

BundlePath.description: A file's path in the plugin folder.
